history_summary: Ground two T1 reference descriptors and retain three complete ambiguity sets.
history_details: Two native reference blocks and three complete ambiguity sets change five existing descriptors and append two native inline events. The unselected Re2 descriptor, including all 23 old alternatives and its MALDI best-match note, remains semantically unchanged; native YAML serialization only moves that note key. Keep all six Re1-Re6 study stocks, every MALDI score and reference-match qualification, source quotations, biological claims and old history. A MALDI best match is not a deposited-stock alias, and no native alternative or species-reference population establishes a study-stock genome. Preserve measured parent-removal outcomes separately from predicted pathway mediation, and preserve the exact existing graph and historical findings. The native log processes six taxa while the status event correctly records five changed descriptors. The retained crosswalk release is unestablished. This partial technical correction does not complete scientific review or corpus QC.
